items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs NE due to foot injury.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf, other PIT WRs elevated targets.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest injury on slate as QUESTIONABLE; practiced Friday, affects Herbert and LAC projections heavily; game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Rib/chest injury from Week 1; full practice Fri after DNPs.
items.implication: If out, QJ/Tre Harris route spikes; Herbert projections drop.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris high route % if McConkey sits.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) listed OUT OR DOUBTFUL for Sunday; confirmed ruled out after missing practices.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; Grade 1 but ruled out.
items.implication: HOU WR room thinned; volume to remaining WRs/TE.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dalton Schultz, Kayshon Boutte, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel.

items.text: Zay Flowers and Ja'Kobi Lane listed OUT OR DOUBTFUL; Flowers doubtful after limited/return practice.
items.why: Hamstring aggravation; missed practices then limited return but doubtful designation.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy shifts to Bateman et al.; crumbs available.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker elevated; Mark Andrews target bump possible.

items.text: Brock Bowers listed OUT OR DOUBTFUL; practiced but doubtful vs LAC.
items.why: Meniscus-related; surprise practice but doubtful tag.
items.implication: LV TE volume elsewhere if sits.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or other TEs/WRs for routes/targets.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go / said he's playing despite QUESTIONABLE (back); listed Q but expected active.
items.why: Back injury but self-reported playing; good to go reports.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength; Chase/Higgins secure.

items.text: Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); Donald plans to play MNF. Monitor for Monday status.
items.why: Hip added to report; related to prior psoas possible.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams elevated if Nacua sits/limits.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR; potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson amid nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ankle cleared; full practices; 'ready to go'; AJ Brown on IR.
items.implication: Shared backfield but explosive upside; Stevenson share dips.
items.opportunity: 10+ touches possible; goal-line/third-down mix; schedule PIT-JAX-BUF etc.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; expected back, squeezing Etienne.
items.implication: NO RBBC tighter; Etienne passing/early-down squeeze.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty (99 util score, 19% tgt share recent) @ LAC and Bucky Irving (26% tgt, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell) vs CLE.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ target share (tied lead), 40% routes targeted, 74% snaps/21 of 24 RB touches through 3Q; Indy soft vs run.
HATE Travis Etienne (Kamara return squeezes; matched Miller rushes, air-dependent) @ BAL; Marvin Harrison Jr. (8% tgt share, 0 RZ, 5th on team) vs SEA.
LOVE Justin Jefferson (37% tgt w/ Wentz, strong hist) @ CHI; DeVonta Smith (27% tgt, 13.7 aDOT) @ TEN; Dalton Kincaid (69% routes career-high, high util) vs DET. Also Dak, Evans.
